title: Second Prospective Cohort of Patients Entering the Multidisciplinary Care Pathway for Post-Covid Syndromes - SyPoCo2 Cohort
official: Second Prospective Cohort of Patients Entering the Multidisciplinary Care Pathway for Post-Covid Syndromes - SyPoCo2 Cohort
summary: The study aims to identify clinical profiles of long-COVID patients and correlate them with immunological and molecular data in order to identify prognostic biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Documented SARS-CoV-2 infection
* Persistent or complex post-COVID symptoms lasting more than 4 weeks or more than 3 months
* Patient referred to the EPSILON pathway or to the post-COVID rehabilitation unit
* Age ≥ 18 years
* Non-institutionalized
* Expected survival greater than 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate or to share data
* Uncontrolled comorbidities
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women
* Persons under legal protection or deprived of liberty
* Not affiliated with the French national health insurance system
